# create_html_artifact — one-pager output

## Purpose
This tool exists for exactly one job, and it is a narrow one: producing a static overview or summary of a larger, already-completed body of work, packaged as a shareable one-pager. Good examples of what belongs here: a finished report summarizing findings, a wrap-up of a multi-step task the user just finished with you, a consolidated view of results gathered across a conversation, or a polished recap someone could forward to a colleague without further editing. This is not a general-purpose "make it look nicer" formatter, and it is not a way to make any output feel more finished — most of what you produce in a conversation, including long or well-organized answers, should still just be a normal chat reply. Three rules make this concrete:
1. Only for an overview or summary of a completed body of work. If the content you're about to generate is itself the primary deliverable — a single answer to a question, one example, one explanation — it does not qualify, even if it's long, even if it's detailed, and even if formatting it as a page would look good. Ask yourself: "is this a recap of work already done, or is this the work itself?" If it's the work itself, this tool is the wrong choice.
2. Static content only, with no exceptions. <script> tags and all inline event handlers are stripped automatically when the artifact is saved, so nothing you produce through this tool can ever actually be interactive, no matter how it's written — buttons won't click, forms won't submit, calculators won't calculate. If the user is asking for something that needs to actually work — an app, a calculator, a live dashboard, anything with real behavior — this tool cannot deliver that and you should use file generation instead, not this tool.
3. Never a substitute for a code snippet or a mermaid diagram, even when the underlying content happens to be HTML or CSS. If what the user actually wants is a code example, a template, a demonstration of how something is built, or a diagram of a flow or architecture, the right home for that is a fenced code block or a mermaid diagram directly in your chat reply — not this tool, even if you could technically wrap that same content in an HTML page.
When you're not sure whether a given request matches this purpose, the safe default is to not call this tool and just reply inline instead. It is far better to under-use this tool than to over-use it.

## Do NOT use this tool for
- Short answers, or anything that would read naturally as a normal inline chat reply — if it would work fine as regular text, leave it as regular text.
- Code snippets, examples, templates, tutorials, or demonstrations of how to build something — this holds true even if the output would technically be a full, well-structured HTML page.
- Diagrams, flows, architecture sketches, or anything that is fundamentally a diagram rather than a document — use a mermaid code block for these instead.
- Anything interactive: forms, calculators, small apps, live dashboards, or any UI element that implies the user will click, type, or interact with it and expect a real response. Remember: this tool cannot produce working interactivity under any circumstances.

## When you do call this tool
- The tool call must be the last action you take in the turn — do not add more content after it. Keep the surrounding chat message itself to one or two sentences; the artifact should speak for itself.
- Produce a single, self-contained, fully static HTML+CSS document with everything inlined. Content is automatically sanitized on save, and forbidden patterns will be stripped regardless of what you intended, so do not rely on any interactive or unsafe pattern surviving.
- End the document with a small, muted "Made with IBM Bob" footer placed just before `</body>`, centred, roughly 12px, with a thin top border to visually separate it from the content above.
- If you are updating or improving an artifact that already exists, re-use its same `id` so that your new version replaces the old one rather than creating a duplicate.

## Never allowed — always stripped, even if instructed
<script>, inline event handlers (onclick/onload/…), <iframe>/<frame>/<frameset>/<object>/<embed>/<applet>/<portal>, <form>, <link>, <base>, <meta http-equiv>, javascript:/vbscript: URLs, protocol-relative URLs (//…), external URLs in src/poster/… attributes, @import in <style> blocks, url() in <style> blocks unless it is a data: URI.
<a href> to external sites is fine. Inline data: image URIs are fine.

## Design
Single column, max-width ~760px, centred. No animations, gradients, shadows, emojis, or decorative icons. SVG only for data visualisation.
Font: `-apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif`, ~14–15px, line-height ~1.6.
Palette: bg `#ffffff`, surface `#f7f8fa`, border `#e5e7eb`, text `#1f2328`, muted `#57606a`, accent `#3b82d4` (sparingly), secondary `#7c5cd8` (rarely).

# glob — file search
Use `glob` to find files by name pattern (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.ts"). Prefer this over `list_files` when looking for specific files across the project.
Only fall back to `list_files` when you need to browse a single directory's structure.

# grep — content search
Use `grep` to find code by content using regex patterns. Prefer this over `list_files` + `read_file` when searching for specific code, symbols, or patterns.
Use `read_file` only after grep tells you which file and lines to look at.

# Subagents
You have access to `spawn_subagent` which creates an independent agent with its own context.

**Default: do the work yourself.** Most tasks are faster and cheaper without a subagent.
Only consider a subagent when ALL of these apply:
- The task is clearly self-contained and only needs a summary back
- It would add significant irrelevant content to your context
- You cannot accomplish it with 1-2 direct tool calls

Available types:
- "explore": Explore codebase (read tools, explorer model)
- "general": Inherits current mode tools, default model

**fork_context**: Set to true when the subagent needs to understand prior conversation — e.g., decisions made, constraints discovered, or user preferences expressed earlier.
Leave false (default) when the description alone is sufficient context.

Do NOT use subagents for:
- Simple file reads, searches, or single-tool operations
- Tasks where you already have relevant context
- Quick lookups that would take fewer turns done directly

# create_chart — chart output
Use the `create_chart` tool when the user asks for a chart or data visualisation.

## How it works
Call the tool with:
- `type`: one of LineChart | BarChart | PieChart | ScatterChart | RadarChart | BoxplotChart
- `title`: short human-readable title for the chart tile
- `props`: a JSON string of chart-specific props

The props JSON must be valid for the chosen chart type. Do NOT wrap it in a spec fence.
Example for BarChart:
{"xAxisData":["Jan","Feb","Mar"],"series":[{"name":"Revenue","data":[4200,5800,3900]}],"title":"Monthly Revenue"}

Activate the `create-chart` skill before building props to get the full per-type prop schemas.

# IBM i RPGLE Sample Project

A simple IBM i project demonstrating RPGLE, CL, and DDS source members.

---

## Project Structure

```
ibmi-project/
├── src/
│   ├── QRPGLESRC/           # RPG Free-Format source members
│   │   ├── HELLO.RPGLE      # Hello World program
│   │   └── CALCTAX.RPGLE    # Tax calculation business logic
│   ├── QCLLESRC/            # CL program source members
│   │   └── RUNCL.CLP        # Driver CL to call RPG programs
│   └── QDDSSRC/             # DDS physical/logical file sources
│       └── CUSFILE.PF       # Customer Master physical file
└── README.md
```

---

## Programs

### `HELLO.RPGLE` — Hello World
A simple free-format RPGLE program that displays a greeting message using `DSPLY`.

**To compile on IBM i:**
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/HELLO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(HELLO)
CRTPGM PGM(MYLIB/HELLO) MODULE(MYLIB/HELLO)
```
Or use the single-step command:
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/HELLO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(HELLO)
```

---

### `CALCTAX.RPGLE` — Tax Calculator
A free-format RPGLE **subprogram** that accepts 4 parameters and returns tax amount and total.

| Parameter | Direction | Type        | Description              |
|-----------|-----------|-------------|--------------------------|
| pAmount   | Input     | Packed(11:2)| Pre-tax amount           |
| pTaxRate  | Input     | Packed(5:2) | Tax rate (e.g., 8.50)    |
| pTaxAmt   | Output    | Packed(11:2)| Calculated tax           |
| pTotal    | Output    | Packed(11:2)| Total (amount + tax)     |

**To compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
```

---

### `RUNCL.CLP` — CL Driver
A CL program that calls both `HELLO` and `CALCTAX` and sends an informational message when complete.

**To compile:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(RUNCL)
```

**To run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)
```

---

### `CUSFILE.PF` — Customer Physical File (DDS)
A DDS physical file definition for a Customer Master table with a unique key on `CUSNUM`.

| Field   | Type       | Description          |
|---------|------------|----------------------|
| CUSNUM  | Packed 7,0 | Customer Number (Key)|
| CUSNAM  | Char 30    | Customer Name        |
| CUSADR  | Char 40    | Customer Address     |
| CUSBAL  | Packed 11,2| Customer Balance     |
| CUSDAT  | Packed 8,0 | Last Activity Date   |

**To compile:**
```
CRTPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
```

---

## Requirements

- IBM i 7.1 or later
- ILE RPG compiler (`CRTBNDRPG` / `CRTRPGMOD`)
- ILE CL compiler (`CRTCLPGM`)
- A target library (e.g., `MYLIB`) created with `CRTLIB LIB(MYLIB)`

---

## Recommended Tools

- [IBM i extension for VS Code](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=HalcyonTechLtd.code-for-ibmi) — edit, compile, and debug directly from VS Code
- [RDi (Rational Developer for i)](https://www.ibm.com/products/rational-developer-for-i) — full IBM IDE for IBM i development

+/* ============================================================ */
+/* Program  : MKBNDDIR                                         */
+/* Purpose  : Build script - Create binding directory and      */
+/*            register UTILS service program                   */
+/* Author   : IBM i Project                                    */
+/* Date     : 2025                                             */
+/*                                                             */
+/* Run this CL once after compiling UTILS to set up the        */
+/* binding directory used by all programs in this project.     */
+/* ============================================================ */
+PGM PARM(&LIB)
+
+    DCL VAR(&LIB) TYPE(*CHAR) LEN(10)
+
+    /* --- Step 1: Compile the UTILS module ----------------- */
+    CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&LIB/UTILS) +
+              SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) +
+              SRCMBR(UTILS) +
+              DBGVIEW(*SOURCE)
+
+    /* --- Step 2: Create the Service Program --------------- */
+    CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/UTILS) +
+              MODULE(&LIB/UTILS) +
+              EXPORT(*ALL) +
+              TEXT('Utility Service Program') +
+              ACTGRP(*CALLER)
+
+    /* --- Step 3: Create the Binding Directory ------------- */
+    CRTBNDDIR BNDDIR(&LIB/UTILBND) +
+              TEXT('Utility Binding Directory')
+
+    /* --- Step 4: Add UTILS service program to bnd dir ----- */
+    ADDBNDDIRE BNDDIR(&LIB/UTILBND) +
+               OBJ((*LIBL/UTILS *SRVPGM))
+
+    SNDPGMMSG MSG('UTILBND binding directory created successfully.') +
+              TOPGMQ(*EXT) MSGTYPE(*INFO)
+
+ENDPGM

arguments.content:
# IBM i RPGLE Sample Project

A complete IBM i project demonstrating RPGLE, CL, DDS, display files, and service programs.

---

## Project Structure

```
ibmi-project/
├── src/
│   ├── QRPGLESRC/               # RPG Free-Format source members
│   │   ├── HELLO.RPGLE          # Hello World program
│   │   ├── CALCTAX.RPGLE        # Tax calculation subprogram
│   │   ├── CUSIO.RPGLE          # Customer File I/O (Add/Read/List)
│   │   ├── CUSMAINTP.RPGLE      # Interactive Customer Maintenance screen
│   │   ├── UTILS.RPGLE          # Utility service program (NoMain module)
│   │   └── UTILSPROT.RPGLE      # Prototype /Copy member for UTILS
│   ├── QCLLESRC/                # CL program source members
│   │   ├── RUNCL.CLP            # Driver CL to call RPG programs
│   │   └── MKBNDDIR.CLP         # Build script: creates UTILBND binding dir
│   └── QDDSSRC/                 # DDS physical/logical/display file sources
│       ├── CUSFILE.PF           # Customer Master physical file
│       └── CUSMAINT.DSPF        # Customer Maintenance display file
└── README.md
```

---

## Recommended Build Order

Follow this sequence when compiling from scratch into your target library (e.g., `MYLIB`):

```
1. CRTPF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE)    SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
2. CRTDSPF    FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
3. CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')   <- builds UTILS SRVPGM + UTILBND
4. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/HELLO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(HELLO)
5. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX)     SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
6. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSIO)
7. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP)
8. CRTCLPGM   PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC)   SRCMBR(RUNCL)
```

---

## Programs

### `HELLO.RPGLE` — Hello World
A simple free-format RPGLE program that displays a greeting message using `DSPLY`.

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/HELLO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(HELLO)
```

---

### `CALCTAX.RPGLE` — Tax Calculator Subprogram
Accepts 4 parameters and returns the calculated tax amount and total.

| Parameter | Direction | Type         | Description           |
|-----------|-----------|--------------|-----------------------|
| pAmount   | Input     | Packed(11:2) | Pre-tax amount        |
| pTaxRate  | Input     | Packed(5:2)  | Tax rate (e.g., 8.50) |
| pTaxAmt   | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Calculated tax        |
| pTotal    | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Total (amount + tax)  |

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
```

---

### `CUSFILE.PF` — Customer Physical File (DDS)
Physical file definition for the Customer Master table with unique key on `CUSNUM`.

| Field   | Type        | Description           |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|
| CUSNUM  | Packed 7,0  | Customer Number (Key) |
| CUSNAM  | Char 30     | Customer Name         |
| CUSADR  | Char 40     | Customer Address      |
| CUSBAL  | Packed 11,2 | Customer Balance      |
| CUSDAT  | Packed 8,0  | Last Activity Date    |

**Compile:**
```
CRTPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
```

---

### `CUSIO.RPGLE` — Customer File I/O
Demonstrates adding, reading by key, and listing all records from `CUSFILE`.
- Uses `CHAIN` for keyed reads
- Uses `SETLL` + `READ` loop for sequential reads
- Uses `WRITE` for adding new records

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSIO)
```

---

### `CUSMAINT.DSPF` — Customer Maintenance Display File (DDS)
A workstation display file with:
- Input fields for all customer columns
- Error message indicators (record not found / duplicate key)
- `F3=Exit`, `F5=Refresh`, `F12=Cancel` function keys
- A message subfile for user feedback at the bottom of the screen

**Compile:**
```
CRTDSPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
```

---

### `CUSMAINTP.RPGLE` — Interactive Customer Maintenance Program
An interactive program that drives the `CUSMAINT` display file. Supports:
- **Add** — if the entered customer number doesn't exist, a new record is written
- **Change** — if the record exists, all fields are updated
- **Refresh (F5)** — re-reads the record from file and populates screen fields
- **Cancel (F12)** — clears all screen fields
- Calls `FormatCurrency` and `GetCurrentDate` from the `UTILS` service program

**Requires:** `UTILBND` binding directory (run `MKBNDDIR` first)

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP) BNDDIR(MYLIB/UTILBND)
```

**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)
```

---

### `UTILS.RPGLE` — Utility Service Program Module
A `NoMain` RPGLE module compiled into a service program (`SRVPGM`). Exports 4 procedures:

| Procedure        | Returns   | Description                                      |
|------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `FormatCurrency` | Char(20)  | Formats a packed decimal as `$1,234.56`          |
| `GetCurrentDate` | Packed(8) | Returns today's date as 8-digit `YYYYMMDD`       |
| `PadLeft`        | Char(50)  | Left-pads a string to a target length            |
| `IsNumeric`      | Indicator | Returns `*On` if a string contains only digits   |

### `UTILSPROT.RPGLE` — Prototype /Copy Member
Paste `/Copy QRPGLESRC,UTILSPROT` into any program that calls the UTILS service program.

**Compile UTILS service program** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(UTILS)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/UTILS) MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

---

### `MKBNDDIR.CLP` — Binding Directory Build Script
A CL build script that automates creation of the binding directory in one step:
1. Compiles `UTILS` module
2. Creates `UTILS` service program
3. Creates `UTILBND` binding directory
4. Adds `UTILS` to the binding directory

**Compile:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(MKBNDDIR)
```
**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')
```

---

### `RUNCL.CLP` — CL Driver
Calls `HELLO` and `CALCTAX` in sequence and sends a completion message.

**Compile & Run:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(RUNCL)
CALL PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)
```

---

## Requirements

- IBM i 7.1 or later
- ILE RPG compiler (`CRTBNDRPG` / `CRTRPGMOD` / `CRTSRVPGM`)
- ILE CL compiler (`CRTCLPGM`)
- DDS compiler (`CRTPF`, `CRTDSPF`)
- A target library — `CRTLIB LIB(MYLIB)`

---

## Recommended Tools

- [IBM i extension for VS Code](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=HalcyonTechLtd.code-for-ibmi) — edit, compile, and debug directly from VS Code
- [RDi (Rational Developer for i)](https://www.ibm.com/products/rational-developer-for-i) — full IBM IDE for IBM i development

# IBM i RPGLE Sample Project

A complete IBM i project demonstrating RPGLE, CL, DDS, display files, and service programs.

---

## Project Structure

```
ibmi-project/
├── src/
│   ├── QRPGLESRC/               # RPG Free-Format source members
│   │   ├── HELLO.RPGLE          # Hello World program
│   │   ├── CALCTAX.RPGLE        # Tax calculation subprogram
│   │   ├── CUSIO.RPGLE          # Customer File I/O (Add/Read/List)
│   │   ├── CUSMAINTP.RPGLE      # Interactive Customer Maintenance screen
│   │   ├── UTILS.RPGLE          # Utility service program (NoMain module)
│   │   └── UTILSPROT.RPGLE      # Prototype /Copy member for UTILS
│   ├── QCLLESRC/                # CL program source members
│   │   ├── RUNCL.CLP            # Driver CL to call RPG programs
│   │   └── MKBNDDIR.CLP         # Build script: creates UTILBND binding dir
│   └── QDDSSRC/                 # DDS physical/logical/display file sources
│       ├── CUSFILE.PF           # Customer Master physical file
│       └── CUSMAINT.DSPF        # Customer Maintenance display file
└── README.md
```

---

## Recommended Build Order

Follow this sequence when compiling from scratch into your target library (e.g., `MYLIB`):

```
1. CRTPF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE)    SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
2. CRTDSPF    FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
3. CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')   <- builds UTILS SRVPGM + UTILBND
4. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/HELLO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(HELLO)
5. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX)     SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
6. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSIO)
7. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP)
8. CRTCLPGM   PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC)   SRCMBR(RUNCL)
```

---

## Programs

### `HELLO.RPGLE` — Hello World
A simple free-format RPGLE program that displays a greeting message using `DSPLY`.

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/HELLO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(HELLO)
```

---

### `CALCTAX.RPGLE` — Tax Calculator Subprogram
Accepts 4 parameters and returns the calculated tax amount and total.

| Parameter | Direction | Type         | Description           |
|-----------|-----------|--------------|-----------------------|
| pAmount   | Input     | Packed(11:2) | Pre-tax amount        |
| pTaxRate  | Input     | Packed(5:2)  | Tax rate (e.g., 8.50) |
| pTaxAmt   | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Calculated tax        |
| pTotal    | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Total (amount + tax)  |

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
```

---

### `CUSFILE.PF` — Customer Physical File (DDS)
Physical file definition for the Customer Master table with unique key on `CUSNUM`.

| Field   | Type        | Description           |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|
| CUSNUM  | Packed 7,0  | Customer Number (Key) |
| CUSNAM  | Char 30     | Customer Name         |
| CUSADR  | Char 40     | Customer Address      |
| CUSBAL  | Packed 11,2 | Customer Balance      |
| CUSDAT  | Packed 8,0  | Last Activity Date    |

**Compile:**
```
CRTPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
```

---

### `CUSIO.RPGLE` — Customer File I/O
Demonstrates adding, reading by key, and listing all records from `CUSFILE`.
- Uses `CHAIN` for keyed reads
- Uses `SETLL` + `READ` loop for sequential reads
- Uses `WRITE` for adding new records

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSIO)
```

---

### `CUSMAINT.DSPF` — Customer Maintenance Display File (DDS)
A workstation display file with:
- Input fields for all customer columns
- Error message indicators (record not found / duplicate key)
- `F3=Exit`, `F5=Refresh`, `F12=Cancel` function keys
- A message subfile for user feedback at the bottom of the screen

**Compile:**
```
CRTDSPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
```

---

### `CUSMAINTP.RPGLE` — Interactive Customer Maintenance Program
An interactive program that drives the `CUSMAINT` display file. Supports:
- **Add** — if the entered customer number doesn't exist, a new record is written
- **Change** — if the record exists, all fields are updated
- **Refresh (F5)** — re-reads the record from file and populates screen fields
- **Cancel (F12)** — clears all screen fields
- Calls `FormatCurrency` and `GetCurrentDate` from the `UTILS` service program

**Requires:** `UTILBND` binding directory (run `MKBNDDIR` first)

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP) BNDDIR(MYLIB/UTILBND)
```

**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)
```

---

### `UTILS.RPGLE` — Utility Service Program Module
A `NoMain` RPGLE module compiled into a service program (`SRVPGM`). Exports 4 procedures:

| Procedure        | Returns   | Description                                      |
|------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `FormatCurrency` | Char(20)  | Formats a packed decimal as `$1,234.56`          |
| `GetCurrentDate` | Packed(8) | Returns today's date as 8-digit `YYYYMMDD`       |
| `PadLeft`        | Char(50)  | Left-pads a string to a target length            |
| `IsNumeric`      | Indicator | Returns `*On` if a string contains only digits   |

### `UTILSPROT.RPGLE` — Prototype /Copy Member
Paste `/Copy QRPGLESRC,UTILSPROT` into any program that calls the UTILS service program.

**Compile UTILS service program** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(UTILS)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/UTILS) MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

---

### `MKBNDDIR.CLP` — Binding Directory Build Script
A CL build script that automates creation of the binding directory in one step:
1. Compiles `UTILS` module
2. Creates `UTILS` service program
3. Creates `UTILBND` binding directory
4. Adds `UTILS` to the binding directory

**Compile:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(MKBNDDIR)
```
**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')
```

---

### `RUNCL.CLP` — CL Driver
Calls `HELLO` and `CALCTAX` in sequence and sends a completion message.

**Compile & Run:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(RUNCL)
CALL PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)
```

---

## Requirements

- IBM i 7.1 or later
- ILE RPG compiler (`CRTBNDRPG` / `CRTRPGMOD` / `CRTSRVPGM`)
- ILE CL compiler (`CRTCLPGM`)
- DDS compiler (`CRTPF`, `CRTDSPF`)
- A target library — `CRTLIB LIB(MYLIB)`

---

## Recommended Tools

- [IBM i extension for VS Code](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=HalcyonTechLtd.code-for-ibmi) — edit, compile, and debug directly from VS Code
- [RDi (Rational Developer for i)](https://www.ibm.com/products/rational-developer-for-i) — full IBM IDE for IBM i development

```

## Programs

### `HELLO.RPGLE` — Hello World
A simple free-format RPGLE program that displays a greeting message using `DSPLY`.

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/HELLO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(HELLO)
```

---

### `CALCTAX.RPGLE` — Tax Calculator Subprogram
Accepts 4 parameters and returns the calculated tax amount and total.

| Parameter | Direction | Type         | Description           |
|-----------|-----------|--------------|-----------------------|
| pAmount   | Input     | Packed(11:2) | Pre-tax amount        |
| pTaxRate  | Input     | Packed(5:2)  | Tax rate (e.g., 8.50) |
| pTaxAmt   | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Calculated tax        |
| pTotal    | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Total (amount + tax)  |

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
```

---

### `CUSFILE.PF` — Customer Physical File (DDS)
Physical file definition for the Customer Master table with unique key on `CUSNUM`.

| Field   | Type        | Description           |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|
| CUSNUM  | Packed 7,0  | Customer Number (Key) |
| CUSNAM  | Char 30     | Customer Name         |
| CUSADR  | Char 40     | Customer Address      |
| CUSBAL  | Packed 11,2 | Customer Balance      |
| CUSDAT  | Packed 8,0  | Last Activity Date    |

**Compile:**
```
CRTPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
```

---

### `CUSIO.RPGLE` — Customer File I/O
Demonstrates adding, reading by key, and listing all records from `CUSFILE`.
- Uses `CHAIN` for keyed reads
- Uses `SETLL` + `READ` loop for sequential reads
- Uses `WRITE` for adding new records

# IBM i RPGLE Sample Project

## Project Structure

```

│   ├── QRPGLESRC/               # RPG Free-Format source members
│   │   ├── HELLO.RPGLE          # Hello World program
│   │   ├── CALCTAX.RPGLE        # Tax calculation subprogram
│   │   ├── CUSIO.RPGLE          # Customer File I/O (Add/Read/List)
│   │   ├── CUSMAINTP.RPGLE      # Interactive Customer Maintenance screen
│   │   ├── CUSSQL.RPGLE         # Embedded SQL: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CURSOR
│   │   ├── UTILS.RPGLE          # Utility service program (NoMain module)
│   │   ├── UTILSPROT.RPGLE      # Prototype /Copy member for UTILS
│   │   ├── ERRLOG.RPGLE         # Error logging via QMHSNDPM API (NoMain)
│   │   └── ERRLOGPROT.RPGLE     # Prototype /Copy member for ERRLOG
│   ├── QCLLESRC/                # CL program source members
│   │   ├── RUNCL.CLP            # Driver CL to call RPG programs
│   │   └── MKBNDDIR.CLP         # Build script: creates UTILBND binding dir
│   └── QDDSSRC/                 # DDS physical/logical/display file sources
│       ├── CUSFILE.PF           # Customer Master physical file
│       ├── CUSBYNAM.LF          # Logical File: Customer keyed by Name

## Recommended Build Order

Follow this sequence when compiling from scratch into your target library (e.g., `MYLIB`):

```
1.  CRTPF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE)    SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
2.  CRTLF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYNAM)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSBYNAM)

5.  CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')  <- builds UTILS+ERRLOG SRVPGMs + UTILBND
6.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/HELLO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(HELLO)
7.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX)     SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
8.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSIO)
9.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP)
10. CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(MYLIB/CUSSQL)      SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSSQL)   OBJTYPE(*PGM)
11. CRTCLPGM   PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC)   SRCMBR(RUNCL)

### `CUSBYNAM.LF` — Logical File: Customer by Name
An alternate-key logical file over `CUSFILE`, keyed by `CUSNAM`. Use this when you need to look up or list customers in alphabetical name order.

**Compile:**
```
CRTLF FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYNAM) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSBYNAM)
```

**Usage in RPGLE:**
```rpgle
Dcl-F CUSBYNAM Usage(*Input) Keyed;
// CHAIN by name
CUSNAM = 'ACME Corporation';
Chain CUSNAM CUSRCD;
```

---

### `CUSBYCIT.LF` — Logical File: Customer by Balance (Descending)
An alternate-key logical file over `CUSFILE`, keyed by `CUSBAL DESCEND`. Useful for reports listing top customers by outstanding balance.

**Compile:**
```
CRTLF FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYCIT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSBYCIT)
```

---

### `CUSSQL.RPGLE` — Embedded SQL Customer Program
Demonstrates all four core SQL operations using embedded SQL (`EXEC SQL`) in free-format RPGLE:

| Operation | SQL Statement | Notes |
|-----------|--------------|-------|
| Add       | `INSERT INTO CUSFILE ... VALUES (...)` | Checks `SQLCODE = -803` for duplicate |
| Change    | `UPDATE CUSFILE SET ... WHERE CUSNUM = :hv` | Updates balance + date |
| List      | `DECLARE CURSOR` + `FETCH` loop | Filters by minimum balance, ordered by `CUSBAL DESC` |
| Remove    | `DELETE FROM CUSFILE WHERE CUSNUM = :hv` | |

**Compile with SQL precompiler:**
```
CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(MYLIB/CUSSQL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSSQL) OBJTYPE(*PGM)
```

---

### `ERRLOG.RPGLE` — Error Logging Service Program (QMHSNDPM)
A `NoMain` RPGLE module that wraps the IBM i `QMHSNDPM` API to provide clean error logging. Exports 3 procedures:

| Procedure  | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `LogInfo`  | Sends an `*INFO` immediate message to the job log |
| `LogError` | Sends a `*DIAG` immediate message to the job log |
| `SndMsgQ`  | Sends an `*INFO` message to any named message queue |

### `ERRLOGPROT.RPGLE` — Prototype /Copy Member for ERRLOG
Paste `/Copy QRPGLESRC,ERRLOGPROT` into any program that calls the ERRLOG service program.

**Usage example in RPGLE:**
```rpgle
/Copy QRPGLESRC,ERRLOGPROT

LogInfo('Customer record processed successfully.');
LogError('CUSFILE CHAIN failed for CUSNUM=' + %Char(CUSNUM));
SndMsgQ('MYMSQ     MYLIB     ' : 'Batch job complete.');
```

**Compile ERRLOG** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/ERRLOG) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(ERRLOG)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/ERRLOG) MODULE(MYLIB/ERRLOG) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

# IBM i RPGLE Sample Project

A complete IBM i project demonstrating RPGLE, CL, DDS, display files, logical files, embedded SQL, service programs, and IBM i API error logging.

---

## Project Structure

```
ibmi-project/
├── src/
│   ├── QRPGLESRC/               # RPG Free-Format source members
│   │   ├── HELLO.RPGLE          # Hello World program
│   │   ├── CALCTAX.RPGLE        # Tax calculation subprogram
│   │   ├── CUSIO.RPGLE          # Customer File I/O (Add/Read/List)
│   │   ├── CUSMAINTP.RPGLE      # Interactive Customer Maintenance screen
│   │   ├── CUSSQL.RPGLE         # Embedded SQL: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CURSOR
│   │   ├── UTILS.RPGLE          # Utility service program (NoMain module)
│   │   ├── UTILSPROT.RPGLE      # Prototype /Copy member for UTILS
│   │   ├── ERRLOG.RPGLE         # Error logging via QMHSNDPM API (NoMain)
│   │   └── ERRLOGPROT.RPGLE     # Prototype /Copy member for ERRLOG
│   ├── QCLLESRC/                # CL program source members
│   │   ├── RUNCL.CLP            # Driver CL to call RPG programs
│   │   └── MKBNDDIR.CLP         # Build script: creates UTILBND binding dir
│   └── QDDSSRC/                 # DDS physical/logical/display file sources
│       ├── CUSFILE.PF           # Customer Master physical file
│       ├── CUSBYNAM.LF          # Logical File: Customer keyed by Name
│       ├── CUSBYCIT.LF          # Logical File: Customer keyed by Balance DESC
│       └── CUSMAINT.DSPF        # Customer Maintenance display file
└── README.md
```

---

## Recommended Build Order

Follow this sequence when compiling from scratch into your target library (e.g., `MYLIB`):

```
1.  CRTPF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE)    SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
2.  CRTLF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYNAM)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSBYNAM)
3.  CRTLF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYCIT)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSBYCIT)
4.  CRTDSPF    FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
5.  CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')  <- builds UTILS+ERRLOG SRVPGMs + UTILBND
6.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/HELLO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(HELLO)
7.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX)     SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
8.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSIO)
9.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP)
10. CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(MYLIB/CUSSQL)      SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSSQL)   OBJTYPE(*PGM)
11. CRTCLPGM   PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC)   SRCMBR(RUNCL)
```

---

## Programs

### `HELLO.RPGLE` — Hello World
A simple free-format RPGLE program that displays a greeting message using `DSPLY`.

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/HELLO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(HELLO)
```

---

### `CALCTAX.RPGLE` — Tax Calculator Subprogram
Accepts 4 parameters and returns the calculated tax amount and total.

| Parameter | Direction | Type         | Description           |
|-----------|-----------|--------------|-----------------------|
| pAmount   | Input     | Packed(11:2) | Pre-tax amount        |
| pTaxRate  | Input     | Packed(5:2)  | Tax rate (e.g., 8.50) |
| pTaxAmt   | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Calculated tax        |
| pTotal    | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Total (amount + tax)  |

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
```

---

### `CUSFILE.PF` — Customer Physical File (DDS)
Physical file definition for the Customer Master table with unique key on `CUSNUM`.

| Field   | Type        | Description           |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|
| CUSNUM  | Packed 7,0  | Customer Number (Key) |
| CUSNAM  | Char 30     | Customer Name         |
| CUSADR  | Char 40     | Customer Address      |
| CUSBAL  | Packed 11,2 | Customer Balance      |
| CUSDAT  | Packed 8,0  | Last Activity Date    |

**Compile:**
```
CRTPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
```

---

### `CUSIO.RPGLE` — Customer File I/O
Demonstrates adding, reading by key, and listing all records from `CUSFILE`.
- Uses `CHAIN` for keyed reads
- Uses `SETLL` + `READ` loop for sequential reads
- Uses `WRITE` for adding new records

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSIO)
```

---

### `CUSMAINT.DSPF` — Customer Maintenance Display File (DDS)
A workstation display file with:
- Input fields for all customer columns
- Error message indicators (record not found / duplicate key)
- `F3=Exit`, `F5=Refresh`, `F12=Cancel` function keys
- A message subfile for user feedback at the bottom of the screen

**Compile:**
```
CRTDSPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
```

---

### `CUSMAINTP.RPGLE` — Interactive Customer Maintenance Program
An interactive program that drives the `CUSMAINT` display file. Supports:
- **Add** — if the entered customer number doesn't exist, a new record is written
- **Change** — if the record exists, all fields are updated
- **Refresh (F5)** — re-reads the record from file and populates screen fields
- **Cancel (F12)** — clears all screen fields
- Calls `FormatCurrency` and `GetCurrentDate` from the `UTILS` service program

**Requires:** `UTILBND` binding directory (run `MKBNDDIR` first)

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP) BNDDIR(MYLIB/UTILBND)
```

**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)
```

---

### `UTILS.RPGLE` — Utility Service Program Module
A `NoMain` RPGLE module compiled into a service program (`SRVPGM`). Exports 4 procedures:

| Procedure        | Returns   | Description                                      |
|------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `FormatCurrency` | Char(20)  | Formats a packed decimal as `$1,234.56`          |
| `GetCurrentDate` | Packed(8) | Returns today's date as 8-digit `YYYYMMDD`       |
| `PadLeft`        | Char(50)  | Left-pads a string to a target length            |
| `IsNumeric`      | Indicator | Returns `*On` if a string contains only digits   |

### `UTILSPROT.RPGLE` — Prototype /Copy Member
Paste `/Copy QRPGLESRC,UTILSPROT` into any program that calls the UTILS service program.

**Compile UTILS service program** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(UTILS)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/UTILS) MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

---

### `MKBNDDIR.CLP` — Binding Directory Build Script
A CL build script that automates creation of the binding directory in one step:
1. Compiles `UTILS` module
2. Creates `UTILS` service program
3. Creates `UTILBND` binding directory
4. Adds `UTILS` to the binding directory

**Compile:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(MKBNDDIR)
```
**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')
```

---

### `RUNCL.CLP` — CL Driver
Calls `HELLO` and `CALCTAX` in sequence and sends a completion message.

**Compile & Run:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(RUNCL)
CALL PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)
```

---

## Requirements

- IBM i 7.1 or later
- ILE RPG compiler (`CRTBNDRPG` / `CRTRPGMOD` / `CRTSRVPGM`)
- ILE CL compiler (`CRTCLPGM`)
- DDS compiler (`CRTPF`, `CRTDSPF`)
- A target library — `CRTLIB LIB(MYLIB)`

---

## Recommended Tools

- [IBM i extension for VS Code](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=HalcyonTechLtd.code-for-ibmi) — edit, compile, and debug directly from VS Code
- [RDi (Rational Developer for i)](https://www.ibm.com/products/rational-developer-for-i) — full IBM IDE for IBM i development

**Usage example in RPGLE:**
```rpgle
/Copy QRPGLESRC,ERRLOGPROT

LogInfo('Customer record processed successfully.');
LogError('CUSFILE CHAIN failed for CUSNUM=' + %Char(CUSNUM));
SndMsgQ('MYMSQ     MYLIB     ' : 'Batch job complete.');
```

**Compile ERRLOG** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/ERRLOG) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(ERRLOG)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/ERRLOG) MODULE(MYLIB/ERRLOG) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

---

### `MKBNDDIR.CLP` — Binding Directory Build Script
A CL build script that automates creation of the binding directory in one step:
1. Compiles `UTILS` module
2. Creates `UTILS` service program
3. Creates `UTILBND` binding directory
4. Adds `UTILS` to the binding directory

**Compile:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(MKBNDDIR)
```
**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')
```

---

### `RUNCL.CLP` — CL Driver
Calls `HELLO` and `CALCTAX` in sequence and sends a completion message.

**Compile & Run:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(RUNCL)
CALL PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)
```

+/* ============================================================ */
+/* Program  : SBMRPT                                           */
+/* Purpose  : Submit Customer Report to Batch                  */
+/* Author   : IBM i Project                                    */
+/* Date     : 2025                                             */
+/*                                                             */
+/* Parameters:                                                 */
+/*   &OUTQ   - Output queue for spooled report (default *JOB) */
+/*   &LIB    - Library containing the programs (default *LIBL) */
+/*                                                             */
+/* This program:                                               */
+/*   1. Validates the output queue exists                      */
+/*   2. Submits CUSRPTP to batch using SBMJOB                  */
+/*   3. Sends a confirmation message to the caller             */
+/* ============================================================ */
+PGM PARM(&OUTQ &LIB)
+
+    DCL VAR(&OUTQ)    TYPE(*CHAR) LEN(10) VALUE('*JOB')
+    DCL VAR(&LIB)     TYPE(*CHAR) LEN(10) VALUE('*LIBL')
+    DCL VAR(&JOBNAME) TYPE(*CHAR) LEN(10) VALUE('CUSRPT')
+    DCL VAR(&MSGTEXT) TYPE(*CHAR) LEN(80)
+    DCL VAR(&ERRMSG)  TYPE(*CHAR) LEN(80)
+
+    /* ---- Monitor for errors ------------------------------ */
+    MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000) EXEC(GOTO CMDLBL(ERRHDLR))
+
+    /* ---- Build confirmation message ---------------------- */
+    CHGVAR VAR(&MSGTEXT) +
+           VALUE('Submitting Customer Report to batch. +
+                  Job: ' *CAT &JOBNAME *TCAT '  OutQ: ' +
+                  *CAT &OUTQ)
+
+    SNDPGMMSG MSG(&MSGTEXT) TOPGMQ(*EXT) MSGTYPE(*INFO)
+
+    /* ---- Submit the report program to batch -------------- */
+    SBMJOB CMD(CALL PGM(&LIB/CUSRPTP)) +
+           JOB(&JOBNAME) +
+           JOBQ(QBATCH) +
+           OUTQ(&OUTQ) +
+           MSGQ(*USRPRF) +
+           LOG(4 00 *SECLVL) +
+           TEXT('Customer Balance Report')
+
+    /* ---- Confirm submission ------------------------------ */
+    CHGVAR VAR(&MSGTEXT) +
+           VALUE('Job ' *CAT &JOBNAME *TCAT +
+                 ' submitted successfully to QBATCH.')
+
+    SNDPGMMSG MSG(&MSGTEXT) TOPGMQ(*EXT) MSGTYPE(*COMP)
+
+    GOTO CMDLBL(DONE)
+
+    /* ---- Error Handler ----------------------------------- */
+    ERRHDLR:
+    CHGVAR VAR(&ERRMSG) +
+           VALUE('SBMRPT failed. Check job log for details.')
+    SNDPGMMSG MSG(&ERRMSG) TOPGMQ(*EXT) MSGTYPE(*ESCAPE)
+
+    DONE:
+ENDPGM

# IBM i RPGLE Sample Project

A complete IBM i project demonstrating RPGLE, CL, DDS, display files, logical files, embedded SQL, service programs, and IBM i API error logging.

---

## Project Structure

```
ibmi-project/
├── src/
│   ├── QRPGLESRC/               # RPG Free-Format source members
│   │   ├── HELLO.RPGLE          # Hello World program
│   │   ├── CALCTAX.RPGLE        # Tax calculation subprogram
│   │   ├── CUSIO.RPGLE          # Customer File I/O (Add/Read/List)
│   │   ├── CUSMAINTP.RPGLE      # Interactive Customer Maintenance screen
│   │   ├── CUSSQL.RPGLE         # Embedded SQL: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CURSOR
│   │   ├── UTILS.RPGLE          # Utility service program (NoMain module)
│   │   ├── UTILSPROT.RPGLE      # Prototype /Copy member for UTILS
│   │   ├── ERRLOG.RPGLE         # Error logging via QMHSNDPM API (NoMain)
│   │   └── ERRLOGPROT.RPGLE     # Prototype /Copy member for ERRLOG
│   ├── QCLLESRC/                # CL program source members
│   │   ├── RUNCL.CLP            # Driver CL to call RPG programs
│   │   └── MKBNDDIR.CLP         # Build script: creates UTILBND binding dir
│   └── QDDSSRC/                 # DDS physical/logical/display file sources
│       ├── CUSFILE.PF           # Customer Master physical file
│       ├── CUSBYNAM.LF          # Logical File: Customer keyed by Name
│       ├── CUSBYCIT.LF          # Logical File: Customer keyed by Balance DESC
│       └── CUSMAINT.DSPF        # Customer Maintenance display file
└── README.md
```

---

## Recommended Build Order

Follow this sequence when compiling from scratch into your target library (e.g., `MYLIB`):

```
1.  CRTPF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE)    SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
2.  CRTLF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYNAM)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSBYNAM)
3.  CRTLF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYCIT)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSBYCIT)
4.  CRTDSPF    FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
5.  CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')  <- builds UTILS+ERRLOG SRVPGMs + UTILBND
6.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/HELLO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(HELLO)
7.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX)     SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
8.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSIO)
9.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP)
10. CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(MYLIB/CUSSQL)      SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSSQL)   OBJTYPE(*PGM)
11. CRTCLPGM   PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC)   SRCMBR(RUNCL)
```

---

## Programs

### `HELLO.RPGLE` — Hello World
A simple free-format RPGLE program that displays a greeting message using `DSPLY`.

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/HELLO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(HELLO)
```

---

### `CALCTAX.RPGLE` — Tax Calculator Subprogram
Accepts 4 parameters and returns the calculated tax amount and total.

| Parameter | Direction | Type         | Description           |
|-----------|-----------|--------------|-----------------------|
| pAmount   | Input     | Packed(11:2) | Pre-tax amount        |
| pTaxRate  | Input     | Packed(5:2)  | Tax rate (e.g., 8.50) |
| pTaxAmt   | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Calculated tax        |
| pTotal    | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Total (amount + tax)  |

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
```

---

### `CUSFILE.PF` — Customer Physical File (DDS)
Physical file definition for the Customer Master table with unique key on `CUSNUM`.

| Field   | Type        | Description           |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|
| CUSNUM  | Packed 7,0  | Customer Number (Key) |
| CUSNAM  | Char 30     | Customer Name         |
| CUSADR  | Char 40     | Customer Address      |
| CUSBAL  | Packed 11,2 | Customer Balance      |
| CUSDAT  | Packed 8,0  | Last Activity Date    |

**Compile:**
```
CRTPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
```

---

### `CUSIO.RPGLE` — Customer File I/O
Demonstrates adding, reading by key, and listing all records from `CUSFILE`.
- Uses `CHAIN` for keyed reads
- Uses `SETLL` + `READ` loop for sequential reads
- Uses `WRITE` for adding new records

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSIO)
```

---

### `CUSMAINT.DSPF` — Customer Maintenance Display File (DDS)
A workstation display file with:
- Input fields for all customer columns
- Error message indicators (record not found / duplicate key)
- `F3=Exit`, `F5=Refresh`, `F12=Cancel` function keys
- A message subfile for user feedback at the bottom of the screen

**Compile:**
```
CRTDSPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
```

---

### `CUSMAINTP.RPGLE` — Interactive Customer Maintenance Program
An interactive program that drives the `CUSMAINT` display file. Supports:
- **Add** — if the entered customer number doesn't exist, a new record is written
- **Change** — if the record exists, all fields are updated
- **Refresh (F5)** — re-reads the record from file and populates screen fields
- **Cancel (F12)** — clears all screen fields
- Calls `FormatCurrency` and `GetCurrentDate` from the `UTILS` service program

**Requires:** `UTILBND` binding directory (run `MKBNDDIR` first)

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP) BNDDIR(MYLIB/UTILBND)
```

**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)
```

---

### `UTILS.RPGLE` — Utility Service Program Module
A `NoMain` RPGLE module compiled into a service program (`SRVPGM`). Exports 4 procedures:

| Procedure        | Returns   | Description                                      |
|------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `FormatCurrency` | Char(20)  | Formats a packed decimal as `$1,234.56`          |
| `GetCurrentDate` | Packed(8) | Returns today's date as 8-digit `YYYYMMDD`       |
| `PadLeft`        | Char(50)  | Left-pads a string to a target length            |
| `IsNumeric`      | Indicator | Returns `*On` if a string contains only digits   |

### `UTILSPROT.RPGLE` — Prototype /Copy Member
Paste `/Copy QRPGLESRC,UTILSPROT` into any program that calls the UTILS service program.

**Compile UTILS service program** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(UTILS)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/UTILS) MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

---

### `CUSBYNAM.LF` — Logical File: Customer by Name
An alternate-key logical file over `CUSFILE`, keyed by `CUSNAM`. Use this when you need to look up or list customers in alphabetical name order.

**Compile:**
```
CRTLF FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYNAM) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSBYNAM)
```

**Usage in RPGLE:**
```rpgle
Dcl-F CUSBYNAM Usage(*Input) Keyed;
// CHAIN by name
CUSNAM = 'ACME Corporation';
Chain CUSNAM CUSRCD;
```

---

### `CUSBYCIT.LF` — Logical File: Customer by Balance (Descending)
An alternate-key logical file over `CUSFILE`, keyed by `CUSBAL DESCEND`. Useful for reports listing top customers by outstanding balance.

**Compile:**
```
CRTLF FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYCIT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSBYCIT)
```

---

### `CUSSQL.RPGLE` — Embedded SQL Customer Program
Demonstrates all four core SQL operations using embedded SQL (`EXEC SQL`) in free-format RPGLE:

| Operation | SQL Statement | Notes |
|-----------|--------------|-------|
| Add       | `INSERT INTO CUSFILE ... VALUES (...)` | Checks `SQLCODE = -803` for duplicate |
| Change    | `UPDATE CUSFILE SET ... WHERE CUSNUM = :hv` | Updates balance + date |
| List      | `DECLARE CURSOR` + `FETCH` loop | Filters by minimum balance, ordered by `CUSBAL DESC` |
| Remove    | `DELETE FROM CUSFILE WHERE CUSNUM = :hv` | |

**Compile with SQL precompiler:**
```
CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(MYLIB/CUSSQL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSSQL) OBJTYPE(*PGM)
```

---

### `ERRLOG.RPGLE` — Error Logging Service Program (QMHSNDPM)
A `NoMain` RPGLE module that wraps the IBM i `QMHSNDPM` API to provide clean error logging. Exports 3 procedures:

| Procedure  | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `LogInfo`  | Sends an `*INFO` immediate message to the job log |
| `LogError` | Sends a `*DIAG` immediate message to the job log |
| `SndMsgQ`  | Sends an `*INFO` message to any named message queue |

### `ERRLOGPROT.RPGLE` — Prototype /Copy Member for ERRLOG
Paste `/Copy QRPGLESRC,ERRLOGPROT` into any program that calls the ERRLOG service program.

**Usage example in RPGLE:**
```rpgle
/Copy QRPGLESRC,ERRLOGPROT

LogInfo('Customer record processed successfully.');
LogError('CUSFILE CHAIN failed for CUSNUM=' + %Char(CUSNUM));
SndMsgQ('MYMSQ     MYLIB     ' : 'Batch job complete.');
```

**Compile ERRLOG** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/ERRLOG) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(ERRLOG)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/ERRLOG) MODULE(MYLIB/ERRLOG) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

---

### `MKBNDDIR.CLP` — Binding Directory Build Script
A CL build script that automates creation of the binding directory in one step:
1. Compiles `UTILS` module
2. Creates `UTILS` service program
3. Creates `UTILBND` binding directory
4. Adds `UTILS` to the binding directory

**Compile:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(MKBNDDIR)
```
**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')
```

---

### `RUNCL.CLP` — CL Driver
Calls `HELLO` and `CALCTAX` in sequence and sends a completion message.

**Compile & Run:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(RUNCL)
CALL PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)
```

---

## Requirements

- IBM i 7.1 or later
- ILE RPG compiler (`CRTBNDRPG` / `CRTRPGMOD` / `CRTSRVPGM`)
- ILE CL compiler (`CRTCLPGM`)
- DDS compiler (`CRTPF`, `CRTLF`, `CRTDSPF`)
- SQL precompiler (`CRTSQLRPGI`) — for `CUSSQL` only
- A target library — `CRTLIB LIB(MYLIB)`

---

## Recommended Tools

- [IBM i extension for VS Code](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=HalcyonTechLtd.code-for-ibmi) — edit, compile, and debug directly from VS Code
- [RDi (Rational Developer for i)](https://www.ibm.com/products/rational-developer-for-i) — full IBM IDE for IBM i development

11. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP)
12. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSLISTP)    SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSLISTP)
13. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSRPTP)     SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSRPTP)
14. CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(MYLIB/CUSSQL)      SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSSQL)   OBJTYPE(*PGM)
15. CRTCLPGM   PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC)   SRCMBR(RUNCL)
16. CRTCLPGM   PGM(MYLIB/SBMRPT)      SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC)   SRCMBR(SBMRPT)
```

---

## Programs

### `HELLO.RPGLE` — Hello World
A simple free-format RPGLE program that displays a greeting message using `DSPLY`.

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/HELLO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(HELLO)
```

---

### `CALCTAX.RPGLE` — Tax Calculator Subprogram
Accepts 4 parameters and returns the calculated tax amount and total.

| Parameter | Direction | Type         | Description           |
|-----------|-----------|--------------|-----------------------|
| pAmount   | Input     | Packed(11:2) | Pre-tax amount        |
| pTaxRate  | Input     | Packed(5:2)  | Tax rate (e.g., 8.50) |
| pTaxAmt   | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Calculated tax        |
| pTotal    | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Total (amount + tax)  |

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
```

---

### `CUSFILE.PF` — Customer Physical File (DDS)
Physical file definition for the Customer Master table with unique key on `CUSNUM`.

| Field   | Type        | Description           |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|
| CUSNUM  | Packed 7,0  | Customer Number (Key) |
| CUSNAM  | Char 30     | Customer Name         |
| CUSADR  | Char 40     | Customer Address      |
| CUSBAL  | Packed 11,2 | Customer Balance      |
| CUSDAT  | Packed 8,0  | Last Activity Date    |

**Compile:**
```
CRTPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
```

---

### `CUSIO.RPGLE` — Customer File I/O
Demonstrates adding, reading by key, and listing all records from `CUSFILE`.
- Uses `CHAIN` for keyed reads
- Uses `SETLL` + `READ` loop for sequential reads
- Uses `WRITE` for adding new records

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSIO)
```

---

### `CUSMAINT.DSPF` — Customer Maintenance Display File (DDS)
A workstation display file with:
- Input fields for all customer columns
- Error message indicators (record not found / duplicate key)
- `F3=Exit`, `F5=Refresh`, `F12=Cancel` function keys
- A message subfile for user feedback at the bottom of the screen

**Compile:**
```
CRTDSPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
```

---

### `CUSMAINTP.RPGLE` — Interactive Customer Maintenance Program
An interactive program that drives the `CUSMAINT` display file. Supports:
- **Add** — if the entered customer number doesn't exist, a new record is written
- **Change** — if the record exists, all fields are updated
- **Refresh (F5)** — re-reads the record from file and populates screen fields
- **Cancel (F12)** — clears all screen fields
- Calls `FormatCurrency` and `GetCurrentDate` from the `UTILS` service program

**Requires:** `UTILBND` binding directory (run `MKBNDDIR` first)

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP) BNDDIR(MYLIB/UTILBND)
```

**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)
```

---

### `UTILS.RPGLE` — Utility Service Program Module
A `NoMain` RPGLE module compiled into a service program (`SRVPGM`). Exports 4 procedures:

| Procedure        | Returns   | Description                                      |
|------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `FormatCurrency` | Char(20)  | Formats a packed decimal as `$1,234.56`          |
| `GetCurrentDate` | Packed(8) | Returns today's date as 8-digit `YYYYMMDD`       |
| `PadLeft`        | Char(50)  | Left-pads a string to a target length            |
| `IsNumeric`      | Indicator | Returns `*On` if a string contains only digits   |

### `UTILSPROT.RPGLE` — Prototype /Copy Member
Paste `/Copy QRPGLESRC,UTILSPROT` into any program that calls the UTILS service program.

**Compile UTILS service program** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(UTILS)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/UTILS) MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

---

### `CUSBYNAM.LF` — Logical File: Customer by Name
An alternate-key logical file over `CUSFILE`, keyed by `CUSNAM`. Use this when you need to look up or list customers in alphabetical name order.

**Compile:**
```
CRTLF FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYNAM) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSBYNAM)
```

**Usage in RPGLE:**
```rpgle
Dcl-F CUSBYNAM Usage(*Input) Keyed;
// CHAIN by name
CUSNAM = 'ACME Corporation';
Chain CUSNAM CUSRCD;
```

---

### `CUSBYCIT.LF` — Logical File: Customer by Balance (Descending)
An alternate-key logical file over `CUSFILE`, keyed by `CUSBAL DESCEND`. Useful for reports listing top customers by outstanding balance.

**Compile:**
```
CRTLF FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYCIT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSBYCIT)
```

---

### `CUSSQL.RPGLE` — Embedded SQL Customer Program
Demonstrates all four core SQL operations using embedded SQL (`EXEC SQL`) in free-format RPGLE:

| Operation | SQL Statement | Notes |
|-----------|--------------|-------|
| Add       | `INSERT INTO CUSFILE ... VALUES (...)` | Checks `SQLCODE = -803` for duplicate |
| Change    | `UPDATE CUSFILE SET ... WHERE CUSNUM = :hv` | Updates balance + date |
| List      | `DECLARE CURSOR` + `FETCH` loop | Filters by minimum balance, ordered by `CUSBAL DESC` |
| Remove    | `DELETE FROM CUSFILE WHERE CUSNUM = :hv` | |

**Compile with SQL precompiler:**
```
CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(MYLIB/CUSSQL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSSQL) OBJTYPE(*PGM)
```

---

### `ERRLOG.RPGLE` — Error Logging Service Program (QMHSNDPM)
A `NoMain` RPGLE module that wraps the IBM i `QMHSNDPM` API to provide clean error logging. Exports 3 procedures:

| Procedure  | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `LogInfo`  | Sends an `*INFO` immediate message to the job log |
| `LogError` | Sends a `*DIAG` immediate message to the job log |
| `SndMsgQ`  | Sends an `*INFO` message to any named message queue |

### `ERRLOGPROT.RPGLE` — Prototype /Copy Member for ERRLOG
Paste `/Copy QRPGLESRC,ERRLOGPROT` into any program that calls the ERRLOG service program.

**Usage example in RPGLE:**
```rpgle
/Copy QRPGLESRC,ERRLOGPROT

LogInfo('Customer record processed successfully.');
LogError('CUSFILE CHAIN failed for CUSNUM=' + %Char(CUSNUM));
SndMsgQ('MYMSQ     MYLIB     ' : 'Batch job complete.');
```

**Compile ERRLOG** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/ERRLOG) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(ERRLOG)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/ERRLOG) MODULE(MYLIB/ERRLOG) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

---

### `MKBNDDIR.CLP` — Binding Directory Build Script
A CL build script that automates creation of the binding directory in one step:
1. Compiles `UTILS` module
2. Creates `UTILS` service program
3. Creates `UTILBND` binding directory
4. Adds `UTILS` to the binding directory

**Compile:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(MKBNDDIR)
```
**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')
```

---

### `RUNCL.CLP` — CL Driver
Calls `HELLO` and `CALCTAX` in sequence and sends a completion message.

**Compile & Run:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(RUNCL)
CALL PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)
```

---

## Requirements

- IBM i 7.1 or later
- ILE RPG compiler (`CRTBNDRPG` / `CRTRPGMOD` / `CRTSRVPGM`)
- ILE CL compiler (`CRTCLPGM`)
- DDS compiler (`CRTPF`, `CRTLF`, `CRTDSPF`)
- SQL precompiler (`CRTSQLRPGI`) — for `CUSSQL` only
- A target library — `CRTLIB LIB(MYLIB)`

---

## Recommended Tools

- [IBM i extension for VS Code](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=HalcyonTechLtd.code-for-ibmi) — edit, compile, and debug directly from VS Code
- [RDi (Rational Developer for i)](https://www.ibm.com/products/rational-developer-for-i) — full IBM IDE for IBM i development

### `CUSLISTP.RPGLE` — Customer List Subfile Program
Drives the `CUSLIST` display file. Loads all customers into the subfile and handles user options:

| Option | Action |
|--------|--------|
| `2`    | Change — calls `CUSMAINTP` for the selected row |
| `4`    | Delete — chains to `CUSFILE`, deletes record, logs via `LogInfo` / `LogError` |
| `5`    | Display — logs the selected customer name via `LogInfo` |
| `F5`   | Refresh — reloads the subfile from file |
| `F6`   | Add — calls `CUSMAINTP` then reloads |

**Compile:**

CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSLISTP) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSLISTP) BNDDIR(MYLIB/UTILBND)
```

```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/CUSLISTP)
```

### `CUSRPT.PRTF` — Customer Balance Report Print File
A DDS print file with 5 record formats for a 132-column, 66-line report:

| Record    | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `RPTHEAD` | Page header — company name, report title, date/time, page number |
| `COLHEAD` | Underlined column headings |
| `DETAIL`  | One line per customer: number, name, address, balance, last activity |
| `TOTAL`   | Grand total — record count + total balance (underlined) |
| `PAGEFOOT`| Last page footer — `*** End of Report ***` |

**Compile:**
```
CRTPRTF FILE(MYLIB/CUSRPT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSRPT)
```

### `CUSRPTP.RPGLE` — Customer Balance Report Driver
Reads all customers from `CUSFILE` and drives the `CUSRPT` print file. Features:
- Auto page break using overflow indicator `*In99`
- Running totals for record count and total balance
- Calls `FormatCurrency` from `UTILS` and `LogInfo` from `ERRLOG` on completion

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSRPTP) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSRPTP) BNDDIR(MYLIB/UTILBND)
```
**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/CUSRPTP)
```

### `SBMRPT.CLP` — Submit Report to Batch
Submits `CUSRPTP` to the `QBATCH` job queue using `SBMJOB`. Parameters:

| Parameter | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `&OUTQ`   | `*JOB`  | Output queue for the spooled report |
| `&LIB`    | `*LIBL` | Library containing `CUSRPTP` |

Sends an `*INFO` message before submission and a `*COMP` message on success. Raises `*ESCAPE` on failure.

**Compile:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/SBMRPT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(SBMRPT)
```
**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/SBMRPT) PARM('*JOB' 'MYLIB')
```

# IBM i RPGLE Sample Project

A complete IBM i project demonstrating RPGLE, CL, DDS, display files, subfiles, print files, logical files, embedded SQL, service programs, IBM i API error logging, and batch job submission.

---

## Project Structure

```
ibmi-project/
├── src/
│   ├── QRPGLESRC/               # RPG Free-Format source members
│   │   ├── HELLO.RPGLE          # Hello World program
│   │   ├── CALCTAX.RPGLE        # Tax calculation subprogram
│   │   ├── CUSIO.RPGLE          # Customer File I/O (Add/Read/List)
│   │   ├── CUSMAINTP.RPGLE      # Interactive Customer Maintenance screen
│   │   ├── CUSSQL.RPGLE         # Embedded SQL: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CURSOR
│   │   ├── CUSLISTP.RPGLE       # Subfile list screen program (2/4/5 options)
│   │   ├── CUSRPTP.RPGLE        # Print report driver program
│   │   ├── UTILS.RPGLE          # Utility service program (NoMain module)
│   │   ├── UTILSPROT.RPGLE      # Prototype /Copy member for UTILS
│   │   ├── ERRLOG.RPGLE         # Error logging via QMHSNDPM API (NoMain)
│   │   └── ERRLOGPROT.RPGLE     # Prototype /Copy member for ERRLOG
│   ├── QCLLESRC/                # CL program source members
│   │   ├── RUNCL.CLP            # Driver CL to call RPG programs
│   │   ├── MKBNDDIR.CLP         # Build script: creates UTILBND binding dir
│   │   └── SBMRPT.CLP           # Submit customer report to batch (SBMJOB)
│   └── QDDSSRC/                 # DDS physical/logical/display file sources
│       ├── CUSFILE.PF           # Customer Master physical file
│       ├── CUSBYNAM.LF          # Logical File: Customer keyed by Name
│       ├── CUSBYCIT.LF          # Logical File: Customer keyed by Balance DESC
│       ├── CUSMAINT.DSPF        # Customer Maintenance display file
│       ├── CUSLIST.DSPF         # Subfile list display file (SFLCTL)
│       └── CUSRPT.PRTF          # Customer Balance Report print file
└── README.md
```

---

## Recommended Build Order

Follow this sequence when compiling from scratch into your target library (e.g., `MYLIB`):

```
1.  CRTPF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE)    SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
2.  CRTLF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYNAM)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSBYNAM)
3.  CRTLF      FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYCIT)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSBYCIT)
4.  CRTDSPF    FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
5.  CRTDSPF    FILE(MYLIB/CUSLIST)    SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSLIST)
6.  CRTPRTF    FILE(MYLIB/CUSRPT)     SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC)    SRCMBR(CUSRPT)
7.  CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')  <- builds UTILS+ERRLOG SRVPGMs + UTILBND
8.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/HELLO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(HELLO)
9.  CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX)     SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
10. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSIO)
11. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)   SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP)
12. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSLISTP)    SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSLISTP)
13. CRTBNDRPG  PGM(MYLIB/CUSRPTP)     SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSRPTP)
14. CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(MYLIB/CUSSQL)      SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC)  SRCMBR(CUSSQL)   OBJTYPE(*PGM)
15. CRTCLPGM   PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)       SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC)   SRCMBR(RUNCL)
16. CRTCLPGM   PGM(MYLIB/SBMRPT)      SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC)   SRCMBR(SBMRPT)
```

---

## Programs

### `HELLO.RPGLE` — Hello World
A simple free-format RPGLE program that displays a greeting message using `DSPLY`.

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/HELLO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(HELLO)
```

---

### `CALCTAX.RPGLE` — Tax Calculator Subprogram
Accepts 4 parameters and returns the calculated tax amount and total.

| Parameter | Direction | Type         | Description           |
|-----------|-----------|--------------|-----------------------|
| pAmount   | Input     | Packed(11:2) | Pre-tax amount        |
| pTaxRate  | Input     | Packed(5:2)  | Tax rate (e.g., 8.50) |
| pTaxAmt   | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Calculated tax        |
| pTotal    | Output    | Packed(11:2) | Total (amount + tax)  |

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CALCTAX) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CALCTAX)
```

---

### `CUSFILE.PF` — Customer Physical File (DDS)
Physical file definition for the Customer Master table with unique key on `CUSNUM`.

| Field   | Type        | Description           |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|
| CUSNUM  | Packed 7,0  | Customer Number (Key) |
| CUSNAM  | Char 30     | Customer Name         |
| CUSADR  | Char 40     | Customer Address      |
| CUSBAL  | Packed 11,2 | Customer Balance      |
| CUSDAT  | Packed 8,0  | Last Activity Date    |

**Compile:**
```
CRTPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSFILE) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSFILE)
```

---

### `CUSIO.RPGLE` — Customer File I/O
Demonstrates adding, reading by key, and listing all records from `CUSFILE`.
- Uses `CHAIN` for keyed reads
- Uses `SETLL` + `READ` loop for sequential reads
- Uses `WRITE` for adding new records

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSIO) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSIO)
```

---

### `CUSMAINT.DSPF` — Customer Maintenance Display File (DDS)
A workstation display file with:
- Input fields for all customer columns
- Error message indicators (record not found / duplicate key)
- `F3=Exit`, `F5=Refresh`, `F12=Cancel` function keys
- A message subfile for user feedback at the bottom of the screen

**Compile:**
```
CRTDSPF FILE(MYLIB/CUSMAINT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINT)
```

---

### `CUSMAINTP.RPGLE` — Interactive Customer Maintenance Program
An interactive program that drives the `CUSMAINT` display file. Supports:
- **Add** — if the entered customer number doesn't exist, a new record is written
- **Change** — if the record exists, all fields are updated
- **Refresh (F5)** — re-reads the record from file and populates screen fields
- **Cancel (F12)** — clears all screen fields
- Calls `FormatCurrency` and `GetCurrentDate` from the `UTILS` service program

**Requires:** `UTILBND` binding directory (run `MKBNDDIR` first)

**Compile:**
```
CRTBNDRPG PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSMAINTP) BNDDIR(MYLIB/UTILBND)
```

**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/CUSMAINTP)
```

---

### `UTILS.RPGLE` — Utility Service Program Module
A `NoMain` RPGLE module compiled into a service program (`SRVPGM`). Exports 4 procedures:

| Procedure        | Returns   | Description                                      |
|------------------|-----------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `FormatCurrency` | Char(20)  | Formats a packed decimal as `$1,234.56`          |
| `GetCurrentDate` | Packed(8) | Returns today's date as 8-digit `YYYYMMDD`       |
| `PadLeft`        | Char(50)  | Left-pads a string to a target length            |
| `IsNumeric`      | Indicator | Returns `*On` if a string contains only digits   |

### `UTILSPROT.RPGLE` — Prototype /Copy Member
Paste `/Copy QRPGLESRC,UTILSPROT` into any program that calls the UTILS service program.

**Compile UTILS service program** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(UTILS)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/UTILS) MODULE(MYLIB/UTILS) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

---

### `CUSBYNAM.LF` — Logical File: Customer by Name
An alternate-key logical file over `CUSFILE`, keyed by `CUSNAM`. Use this when you need to look up or list customers in alphabetical name order.

**Compile:**
```
CRTLF FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYNAM) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSBYNAM)
```

**Usage in RPGLE:**
```rpgle
Dcl-F CUSBYNAM Usage(*Input) Keyed;
// CHAIN by name
CUSNAM = 'ACME Corporation';
Chain CUSNAM CUSRCD;
```

---

### `CUSBYCIT.LF` — Logical File: Customer by Balance (Descending)
An alternate-key logical file over `CUSFILE`, keyed by `CUSBAL DESCEND`. Useful for reports listing top customers by outstanding balance.

**Compile:**
```
CRTLF FILE(MYLIB/CUSBYCIT) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(CUSBYCIT)
```

---

### `CUSSQL.RPGLE` — Embedded SQL Customer Program
Demonstrates all four core SQL operations using embedded SQL (`EXEC SQL`) in free-format RPGLE:

| Operation | SQL Statement | Notes |
|-----------|--------------|-------|
| Add       | `INSERT INTO CUSFILE ... VALUES (...)` | Checks `SQLCODE = -803` for duplicate |
| Change    | `UPDATE CUSFILE SET ... WHERE CUSNUM = :hv` | Updates balance + date |
| List      | `DECLARE CURSOR` + `FETCH` loop | Filters by minimum balance, ordered by `CUSBAL DESC` |
| Remove    | `DELETE FROM CUSFILE WHERE CUSNUM = :hv` | |

**Compile with SQL precompiler:**
```
CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(MYLIB/CUSSQL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(CUSSQL) OBJTYPE(*PGM)
```

---

### `ERRLOG.RPGLE` — Error Logging Service Program (QMHSNDPM)
A `NoMain` RPGLE module that wraps the IBM i `QMHSNDPM` API to provide clean error logging. Exports 3 procedures:

| Procedure  | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| `LogInfo`  | Sends an `*INFO` immediate message to the job log |
| `LogError` | Sends a `*DIAG` immediate message to the job log |
| `SndMsgQ`  | Sends an `*INFO` message to any named message queue |

### `ERRLOGPROT.RPGLE` — Prototype /Copy Member for ERRLOG
Paste `/Copy QRPGLESRC,ERRLOGPROT` into any program that calls the ERRLOG service program.

**Usage example in RPGLE:**
```rpgle
/Copy QRPGLESRC,ERRLOGPROT

LogInfo('Customer record processed successfully.');
LogError('CUSFILE CHAIN failed for CUSNUM=' + %Char(CUSNUM));
SndMsgQ('MYMSQ     MYLIB     ' : 'Batch job complete.');
```

**Compile ERRLOG** (or just run `MKBNDDIR`):
```
CRTRPGMOD MODULE(MYLIB/ERRLOG) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(ERRLOG)
CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(MYLIB/ERRLOG) MODULE(MYLIB/ERRLOG) EXPORT(*ALL) ACTGRP(*CALLER)
```

---

### `MKBNDDIR.CLP` — Binding Directory Build Script
A CL build script that automates creation of the binding directory in one step:
1. Compiles `UTILS` module
2. Creates `UTILS` service program
3. Creates `UTILBND` binding directory
4. Adds `UTILS` to the binding directory

**Compile:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(MKBNDDIR)
```
**Run:**
```
CALL PGM(MYLIB/MKBNDDIR) PARM('MYLIB')
```

---

### `RUNCL.CLP` — CL Driver
Calls `HELLO` and `CALCTAX` in sequence and sends a completion message.

**Compile & Run:**
```
CRTCLPGM PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL) SRCFILE(MYLIB/QCLLESRC) SRCMBR(RUNCL)
CALL PGM(MYLIB/RUNCL)
```

---

## Requirements

- IBM i 7.1 or later
- ILE RPG compiler (`CRTBNDRPG` / `CRTRPGMOD` / `CRTSRVPGM`)
- ILE CL compiler (`CRTCLPGM`)
- DDS compiler (`CRTPF`, `CRTLF`, `CRTDSPF`)
- SQL precompiler (`CRTSQLRPGI`) — for `CUSSQL` only
- A target library — `CRTLIB LIB(MYLIB)`

---

## Recommended Tools

- [IBM i extension for VS Code](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=HalcyonTechLtd.code-for-ibmi) — edit, compile, and debug directly from VS Code
- [RDi (Rational Developer for i)](https://www.ibm.com/products/rational-developer-for-i) — full IBM IDE for IBM i development
